title: Definitions: Rent Basis for Service Recovery on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement after Rent Changes
content:
**Definition — rent basis for service recovery (Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement).** In a billing-error correction credit, the service-recovery share is measured on a rent that depends on the agreement's rent change history:

(i) where a rent increase was noticed on the agreement in the last two months, the rent the share is measured on is the new rent of the most recent rent increase notice;

(ii) where no increase was noticed in the last two months but a retention concession was recorded on the agreement in the last 12 months, it is the average of the rent charges posted on the agreement in the last 12 months — the total of those rent charges divided by their number;

(iii) in every other case this definition makes no adjustment to the rent the share is measured on.

**Windows.** A window of the last two months covers notices dated less than two whole calendar months before the handling date; a window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before it; whole months are counted to the same day of the later month. Rent increase notices and retention concessions are read by their notice dates; rent charges by their posting dates.

**Order of the tests.** Item (i) is tested first; item (ii) applies only where item (i) does not.

### Illustrations (hypothetical history)

| Rent change history | Rent the share is measured on |
|---|---|
| Increase noticed 5 weeks ago, new rent $231.00 | $231.00 |
| Increase noticed 5 weeks ago and a concession 3 months ago | $231.00 (item (i) governs) |
| No increase in two months; concession recorded 4 months ago; 12 rent charges in the window totalling $2,604.00 | $217.00 |
| No increase in two months; no concession in 12 months | no adjustment |
